description: This file defines the CacheCommand class which extends an abstract command to manage cache files in the Goteo application. It provides functionality to clear different types of cache such as configuration, language translation, and SQL cache through command-line options.

classes.name: CacheCommand
classes.description: A console command class to manage cache files, including clearing config, language, and SQL cache.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Sets up the command name, description, options, and help text for the cache command.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes the cache clearing logic based on the provided command-line option.
